rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone gives focused attention while listening, watching, or doing something.

example.english: Listen attentively to what I’m saying first.
example.jyutping: zyun1 sam1 gam3 teng1 zyu6 ngo5 gong2 sin1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on paying close attention to what is being heard or observed.

example.english: Listen attentively to what the doctor says.
example.jyutping: lau4 sam1 gam3 teng1 ji1 sang1 dim2 gong2

rows.note: Use this when attentiveness involves examining or inspecting something closely and carefully.

example.traditional: 佢哋仔細咁檢查份合約。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zi2 sai3 gam3 gim2 caa4 fan6 hap6 joek3
